description:
Handcrafted titanium gravel performance. Exceptional value.
The Enigma Esker Signature is handcrafted in our Sussex workshop using Reynolds 3Al/2.5V titanium tubing. Designed for performance-focused gravel riding, the Esker combines responsive handling, stability and the comfort of titanium across varied terrain.
This individually built Esker features Shimano GRX 1x11 gearing, Hunt x QVIST Limitless 40 carbon gravel wheels and a C-Six carbon seatpost. The frame incorporates a T47 bottom bracket, top tube mounting points and UDH compatibility.
SAVE 25% - WAS £7,550, NOW £5,665
Brand new and unused, complete with a full Enigma warranty. Only one available.
Specification

Frame: Enigma Esker Signature, UK-handcrafted Reynolds 3Al/2.5V titanium, custom 56cm-based geometry with a shorter seat tube.

Sizing & Availability

This Esker features custom geometry based on a standard 56cm frame, but with a slightly shorter seat tube. Its overall proportions are therefore broadly comparable to a 56cm Esker.

Please contact us for the full frame geometry and guidance on suitability before purchasing.

One bike available. Save £1,885 on this individually built, UK-handcrafted Signature Esker.
